verdict.rationale: BugSnag is a SaaS error-monitoring service with a Data Access API, so issuing scoped agent credentials is a fair axis. The evidence only shows that API tokens exist, an Authentication docs page, and OAuth 2.0 browser login for the self-hosted MCP server. Nothing documents scoped, read-only, per-project or otherwise least-privilege tokens for an agent, and OAuth login is an adjacent authentication method, not scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Self Hosted MCP Server OAuth 2.0 support — securely connect to BugSnag via browser-based login instead of manual API tokens.
